verdict.rationale: Rippling's own marketing describes built-in AI that does tasks inside the product. It builds reports and dashboards from prompts, lets employees submit qualifying life events, and automatically reviews dependent documents and approves coverage. The evidence covers only scattered, module-specific capabilities on marketing pages, not a general assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to. The 'Delegate tasks' line on the payroll page is about role permissions for people, not AI, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose agent that takes multi-step actions across modules, documentation of the assistant's action scope and controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Have Rippling AI automatically review proof of relationship documents and approve coverage if they’re valid.
Employees can get instant answers to questions, compare plans, and submit qualifying life events with AI, on desktop and mobile.
Use AI to build reports and dashboards on labor cost trends, overtime by location, and more.
